'''J.D. LaCure New School Dagobah Turtle''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[J.D. LaCure]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-4055">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4055 New School Dagobah Turtle], DeckTech (J.D. "Talz" LaCure, 8 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4055/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4055/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018195247/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4055/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[J.D. LaCure]]
* '''Published:''' 8 March 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''New School Dagobah Turtle''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah (Light)|Dagobah-L-dagobah.gif|label=Dagobah}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|The Signal|JP-L-thesignal.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|The Planet That It's Farthest From|SE-L-theplanetthatitsfarthestfrom.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor DL LaCure LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Pull effects quickly and cycle through your deck to take only what you want.  Set up huge drains on Dagobah and retrieve with on/off the edge.  Deploy the systems when CHYBC hits the table.

== Original post ==

'''New School Dagobah Turtle'''
* '''Author:''' J.D. "Talz" LaCure
* '''Published:''' March 8, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Pull effects quickly and cycle through your deck to take only what you want.  Set up huge drains on Dagobah and retrieve with on/off the edge.  Deploy the systems when CHYBC hits the table.

=== Strategy ===

Things to do ASAP get out the Dagobah sites get out traffic control get a ship to Dagobah find Son of Skywalker Deploy SAC counters

then... go through the deck and pick out what you want with traffic control

this includes... retrieving cards the numerous effects ground/cloud drain material at Dagobah

after you are set up you should drain for about 7~9 get your lost pile back down with on/off the edge and watch your opponent die

Come here you big coward wiil kill this deck, if there is any hint of this, deploy the ships to Yavin4 with haven, and move to Courascant

if they start CHYBC and are playing heavy space, you're in trouble
